name: vnd-ai-sdlc
description: VNDIRECT AI-SDLC harness, framework-agnostic layer: architect/reviewer/security agents; process commands (plan-feature, spec, adr, review, security-review, status, agent-metrics, update-memory, abort, pr); a governed skill lifecycle (skill-new, skill-submit, skill-approve, skill-sync) so teams can contribute skills through Jira+PR review and everyone picks them up; and a self-contained bundled MCP server exposing Confluence, Jira, GitHub and Claude Code trigger tools. Pair with vnd-ai-sdlc-stockbook for Flutter/GitLab specifics.
